RootEncoder and RootEncoder extra-sources

License: Apache License 2.0
License text: LICENSE.txt

OSS integrates RootEncoder's shared GL filter chain and surface-backed
source adapters. The extra-sources artifact provides Media3VideoSource and
CameraUvcSource; built-in camera capture uses the core Camera2Source.
Runtime playback, capture, device lifecycle, and performance remain subject
to the documented CI and physical-device acceptance tests.
